title: Chronicle now records what you did
question: Round 31: I gave the chronicle a memory of the playtest, not just the sim -- pouring, walling, dials, speed, rebuilds, and a jar placed all get their own frame-stamped line now, and it autosaves every census row so a crash doesn't lose the run. Could you send me one real chronicle file from a session you've played (a .txt under assets/chronicles/ on your machine, probably the newest one)? I want to show you exactly what an agent can now tell from it that it couldn't before.
context_md: Pictured: `labshot` on `played_bed` at frame 0 and frame 90,000 (no player in this run, so no player-action lines -- this is here to anchor the ask, not to demonstrate the new lines themselves; those need a real session). PR: https://github.com/sgladstein/Pixel_Physics/pull/374
